text:
jamie: deploy-bot raised an automated rollback suggestion for dedicated-pool-3 (runtime v5.1) due to rising memory consumption on 2/3 nodes. autopilot recommended rollback to v5.0. https://grafana/reports/mem-2026 :warning:

deploy-bot: autopilot:rollback_recommendation for rollout/2026-03-21T10:00:01Z 9 reason: memory_leak_rate>0.8. Suggested action: run investigators or approve automated rollback within 10m.

oliver: pinging @kim and @pm-ops. Do we want autopilot to revoke the rollout or do a manual pin and staged drain? Dedicated customers affected.

kim: quick read on metrics: RSS trending up linearly on two nodes, one node OOM'd and restarted. heap-profiler snapshots attached in ops drive. Seems like a runtime GC regressed with v5.1.
jamie: uptime shows restarts ~every 7m on node-a and node-b. Not a transient spike.

pm-ops: Customer impact: 3 out of 12 dedicated pools show degraded throughput; top-tier customers in APAC might see rate-limits. We need a customer comms draft if we roll back.

oliver: proposal: don't let autopilot auto-rollback. Instead do manual pin to v5.0 for affected dedicated pools and leave hosted as-is. Steps: 1) pin dedicated-pool-3 to v5.0; 2) gracefully drain v5.1 nodes; 3) monitor 15m. That buys time for a hotfix.

jamie: agree. How to pin: `releases/pin --pool dedicated-pool-3 --model runtime:v5.0 --duration 2h` (ops has perms).

deploy-bot: note: autopilot action suppressed by human request. Manual override token required: `--force-approve by release:operator`.

kim: hotfix path: revert last GC commit or toggle `runtime_gc_new=false` via kernel flag. If pinning, we should still flip flag on one node to test.

oliver: OK, decision: suppress autopilot rollback. Jamies + Kim to execute pin + flip flag on a single test node. If memory stabilizes in 10m, expand to all affected pools. If not, approve full rollback to v5.0.

pm-ops: please draft customer one-liner: "We're reverting a recent runtime update for a subset of dedicated pools to restore stability. Some customers in APAC may have experienced degraded throughput; we've pinned affected pools and are monitoring."

jamie: executing pin now. `releases/pin --pool dedicated-pool-3 --runtime v5.0 --reason "memory regression"`

releases-bot: change: pin applied to dedicated-pool-3 -> runtime v5.0 (expires in 2h).

jamie: toggling `runtime_gc_new=false` on node-a for test.

(deployment updates)

kim: test node memory trend flattening. that flag dropped RSS on node-a.

oliver: good. roll flag on node-b next, then node-c. If all green, keep pin and schedule a controlled re-release after GC revert.

deploy-bot: autopilot hold resumed for rollout until manual clear.

pm-ops: prepping customer alert and internal release note update. I'll wait 15m of stability before wide notify.

jamie: if any node OOMs again, we escalate to full rollback and CC eng-release leads.

oliver: thumbs. Keep thread small; summary for postmortem: suppressed autopilot rollback, manual pin to v5.0 on affected pool, kernel flag tested as mitigation, follow-up hotfix required.

pm-ops: filing follow-up ticket INF-5421 for root cause and hotfix timeline. Will include rollback comms draft.

jamie: last status @4578920200 9 pinned and 10m stable on test nodes. Will update in 15m.
